description.value:
Duration constant

Every augment in you has a redundant, hand-soldered backup circuit only you know about. Your own installed cyber-augments cannot be shut off by an EMP, a technomancy/disrupt-construct effect, or any other effect that would suppress them, up to and including at Chrome-Bound Drift. This protects function only — it does nothing to a Drift band's other effects, and does nothing for anyone else's hardware, including your Rig's.

cinderfall.incomplete: Reads like Immunity, but Immunity's type field must be a real recognized condition/effect-category slug. "An effect that would suppress cyber-augment function" is a homebrew effect-category with no matching slug anywhere in pf2e-source. Bucket 5, no clean predicate.
